<thought>Search the template catalog with a larger limit to increase the chance of finding a Wolff‑Kishner reduction template (ketone → alkane). Use the same criteria (ketone broken) but request up to 100 templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 100
}</action_input>
